name: Najmul Hasan
description: Najmul Hasan is a Quality Engineering Intern, AI/ML at Rocket Lawyer. His research interests are in the pretraining and post-training of language models, and in how choices in data, architecture, and optimization shape what a model learns and how it behaves. He holds a B.S. in Computer Science with minors in Mathematics and Physics from the University of North Carolina at Pembroke.
